system.description:
Play the Honour Guard if you want to stand on the battlefield and rally your allies with skill and pride.

Features

All for One. When you gain a Style die, you may spend a Hope to give it to an ally instead. When the scene ends, an ally's unspent Style dice are lost.

One for All. Once per Rest, mark a Stress to rally your companions. You and all allies gain Advantage on all rolls until the scene ends or until you roll with Fear.
